decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions and alterations hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 9.00am-9.30pm, 7 days a week.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties)

Condition : 5 - Before plant and/or machinery is used on the premises, it shall be enclosed with sound-insulating material and mounted in a way which will minimise transmission of structure borne sound in accordance with a scheme to be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  To safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential property  in accordance with policy ENV.B.1.1 New development and policy ENV.P.1.5 Noise pollution)

Condition : 6 - The access doorway to the betting shop shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

(Reason.  To provide satisfactory access for people with disabilities in accordance with policy E.1.3 Disabled Access.

Condition : 7 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions it is considered that this application for change of use from A1 (Retail) to A2 (betting shop) would not harm the character or appearance of the area or the vitality of this shopping parade and Hounslow Town Centre. It would not have an unacceptable impact upon the surrounding environment or neighbours' living conditions and does provide adequate access arrangements for disabled people. It complies with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities), E.2.2 (Mixed Uses) and S.1.4 (Non-retail uses in locations outside primary and secondary frontages within the main shopping areas).
description: Change of use from A1 (Retail) to A2 (Licensed Betting Office) incorporating single storey side and rear extensions and alterations to shop front.
